tooltip.simpletweaks.claim_deed.inactive: Claims are disabled by default. Ask the server administrator about protection coverage.
tooltip.simpletweaks.claim_deed.data: Saved deed data is retained; only the server claim ledger grants permission.
config.simpletweaks.claims.enabled.toolt: Implemented stages 1–3, 5 and 6: atomic claims, Vanilla/tool checks, owner trust, OP4 administration and the Dimensions adapter. Stage 4 is a separate unmerged worker; environmental and automation coverage is not established. Default off; enable only for development testing. Default: false.
config.simpletweaks.claims.maxClaimsPerP: Global per-player limit across dimensions. Range 1–256. Existing claims are retained if the limit is lowered. Default: 16.
config.simpletweaks.claims.maxTrustedPla: Maximum trusted UUIDs per claim. Range 0–64. Existing trusts are retained if the limit is lowered. Default: 8.
config.simpletweaks.claims.globalCap.too: Maximum total claims across dimensions. Range 1–10000. Existing claims are never silently removed. Default: 4096.
config.simpletweaks.claims.cooldownTicks: Server ticks between successful claim, trust, revocation or removal operations by one player. Range 20–72000, across dimensions; resets on restart. Default: 100 ticks.
config.simpletweaks.claims.opBypass.tool: Only operators at permission level 4 may bypass protection when enabled. Does not bypass claim caps, spawn or world-border policy. Default: false.
config.simpletweaks.claims.spawnBuffer.t: Claims cannot intersect the world-spawn square. Range 0–256; Vanilla spawn protection is always respected. Default: 16 blocks.
config.simpletweaks.claims.dimensions.to: Allowlist for new claims; up to 32 dimension IDs. Existing claims in other dimensions remain protected. Entire chunks must be inside the world border. Default: Overworld, Nether, End.
command.simpletweaks.claim.locked: Claims are locked because claim data could not be read or saved. Original files were preserved.
command.simpletweaks.claim.stage: Claims implementation stage: %s. Protection remains incomplete.
command.simpletweaks.claim.identity: Use an online player name or a full nonzero UUID for an offline player. Unknown names and selectors are not accepted.
command.simpletweaks.claim.denied: Change refused: ownership, trust limit, cooldown, or unchanged permissions. Only explicit OP4 admin removal bypasses ownership.
